name: Rosewood Amsterdam
insider_take: This ultra-luxe canal palace occupies a former 17th-century courthouse in the heart of Amsterdam's UNESCO-listed canal district, where historic elegance meets contemporary sophistication.
whats_special: The hotel seamlessly blends into five interconnected 17th-century buildings, including the iconic former Palace of Justice. Each room offers unique canal or courtyard views, while the Michelin-starred SPECTRUM restaurant by Sidney Schutte delivers innovative cuisine. The tranquil Sense spa provides an urban oasis with its indoor pool overlooking a peaceful garden courtyard.
pro_tip: Book a Keizersgracht Canal Suite for unobstructed views of Amsterdam's most prestigious canal, and request an evening canal cruise departure directly from the hotel's private dock.
dont_miss: Explore the nearby Nine Streets (De Negen Straatjes) shopping district just steps away, visit the world-renowned Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh Museum within walking distance, and take a sunset stroll along the illuminated Herengracht canal, considered the most beautiful canal in Amsterdam.
pros: Prime canal-side location in historic Amsterdam center
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Luxurious accommodations with canal or courtyard views
World-class dining and sophisticated bar experiences
cons: Limited availability due to exclusive boutique size
